scope: Read-only source audit of UIPetTamingDeceiveWnd and UIWindowMgr factory ID 91

on_create.findings: Empty; does not initialize controls/resources or alter geometry.

send_msg.findings: Only message 80 is handled. If val1==0, stores val2 in m_monGID and returns. Otherwise sets m_destPos=val2, m_delay=7, m_maxDelay=7. No other state is changed.

on_draw.findings: Gets ACT and SPR resources via symbols aSlotmachineAct/aSlotmachineSpr (lines 27880-27883), selects motion index m_curMot/m_delay for m_curAct (27884-27887), draws each clip's sprite using clip x/y plus half window width/height (27907-27917). After drawing, increments m_curMot unless current derived motion equals m_destPos AND m_delay<=m_maxDelay (27925-27927). If derived motion reaches GetMotionCount, resets m_curMot=0 and, when m_destPos!=-1, increments m_delay (27928-27934).

on_lbtn_down.findings: Only when m_isSelected is false: sets m_curAct=1, m_destPos=7, m_isSelected=1, then sends game-mode message 162 with m_monGID and zero args. x/y are ignored; no coordinate/hit check here.

on_process.findings: Invalidates every process call. Computes frame=m_curMot/m_delay. If m_startTick==-1, starts timeGetTime when frame==m_destPos and m_delay<=m_maxDelay. Thereafter deletes window ID 0x5B after same condition remains true for >=0x7D0 (2000 ms). It does not reset the start tick if condition ceases to hold.

factory_91.findings: Reuses m_petTamingDeceiveWnd if non-null and jumps to common show path (SetShow(1)); existing instance is not recreated/repositioned/reinitialized. First creation allocates 0x80 bytes, assigns manager member, UIWindow::Create(196,256), centers at renderer width/2-98 and height/2-128, then common AddWindow and SetShow. Manager constructor initializes member null at line 11401; manager teardown calls PostQuit and clears it at lines 2533-2536.

resource_paths.uncertainty: Exact underlying ACT/SPR string/path cannot be determined from the inspected reference source: these symbols are referenced in OnDraw but no declaration/string definition was found in source. Do not infer filenames from symbol spelling.

transitions: Initial: act=0, mot=0, selected=0, delay=1, destination=-1, maxDelay=10000, startTick=-1.
Message 80 val1=0: store monster GID only.
First click while not selected: act=1, destination=7, selected=1; send game message 162(monGID,0,0). This click does not set delay/maxDelay.
Each draw increments mot except while current frame equals destination under delay<=maxDelay. On reaching motion count, mot resets to 0 and destination!= -1 increments delay.
Process starts a 2-second completion timer only while destination frame is held and delay<=maxDelay; after 2 seconds deletes window numeric ID 0x5B.
draw_geometry: For each ACT clip, destination point is (Clip.x + m_w/2, Clip.y + m_h/2); sprite index from SPR sprite list 0 at Clip.sprIndex. Window factory gives 196x256 and centered origin on first creation. No clipping/hitbox/background handling is visible in this OnDraw implementation.
input_conditions: OnLBtnDown ignores x/y and permits exactly the first selection while m_isSelected==0. The underlying framework may gate delivery by window visibility or hit-testing; this function itself has no such test.
open_questions: Resolve aSlotmachineAct/aSlotmachineSpr to actual resource strings from a string table, binary, or other generated source before hardcoding paths.

Confirm manager AddWindow common path and visibility semantics if implementing lifecycle; inspected factory code shows AddWindow then SetShow only on new instance, while reused path reaches SetShow without AddWindow.

The timer tests the destination condition on process ticks, but does not reset m_startTick when the condition becomes false; subsequent behavior depends on state progression and should be preserved or intentionally verified.
